title: A Day at the Bookshop
setting: A small, bright bookshop with a little cafe corner, on a cold winter day.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: Sam, a young boy with glasses and a yellow hat

sentences.en: In February, Mia and Sam visit a bookshop.
sentences.zh: 二月里，米娅和萨姆去逛一家书店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a yellow hat walk into a small bright bookshop, snowy street behind them.

sentences.en: Mia buys a blue book about birds there.
sentences.zh: 米娅在那里买了一本讲鸟的蓝色书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt holds up a blue book with a bird on the cover at the bookshop counter.

sentences.en: Then they eat egg sandwiches and hot chips.
sentences.zh: 然后他们吃鸡蛋三明治和热薯条。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a yellow hat sit at a little table in the bookshop cafe with egg sandwiches and a bowl of hot chips.

sentences.en: Sam drops his plate, and it breaks.
sentences.zh: 萨姆把盘子掉在地上，盘子摔碎了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a young boy with glasses and a yellow hat looks shocked as his plate falls and breaks into pieces on the floor.

sentences.en: He feels bad, and his face goes red.
sentences.zh: 他觉得很过意不去，脸都红了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a young boy with glasses and a yellow hat stands with a red, embarrassed face next to the broken plate.

sentences.en: Mia finds Sam's hat below the table.
sentences.zh: 米娅在桌子下面找到了萨姆的帽子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt bends down and picks up a yellow hat from under the cafe table.

sentences.en: "Do not lose your hat," she tells him.
sentences.zh: “别把你的帽子弄丢了。”她对他说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt hands the yellow hat back to Sam, a young boy with glasses and a yellow hat, wagging a finger kindly.

sentences.en: Tonight, they will read the new book together.
sentences.zh: 今晚，他们要一起读这本新书。
sentences.scene_prompt: At night, Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt and Sam, a young boy with glasses and a yellow hat sit on a sofa under a lamp reading the blue bird book.
